en: I am going to your house.
The dog is bigger than the cat.
She told me the book is good.
Did you see the dog yesterday?
If it rains we will not go.
sn: Til em i pin en sin lo.
Sin nal ta til yen yin he?
Ran lam har fum nu es i fom nu rum yo.
Til es mi urgo an tir lo.
Huswa em i wan nam he?
Tin dan ta sem o min lo.
